About the treatment

Chemical peels

Chemical peels use different approaches to skin exfoliation. Choosing a product and treatment intensity requires assessing skin type, sensitivity and your current routine. Not every peel is suitable for everyone, and preparation and aftercare depend on the exact method selected.

Our approach

A brief consultation about your skin needs and any relevant limitations is recommended. Preparation and aftercare depend on the exact technique and must be confirmed by the salon.

Before and after your treatment

Treatment suitability, duration and prices are confirmed by the salon.
